extension.description: Sorts class members of Java files, following Eclipse's Sort Members rules. Only sorts, no formatting.
command.title: Java Sorter: Sort Members (Eclipse Style)
config.memberOrder: Specifies the physical sorting order of different member categories. Items not in this list will remain in their original positions if sortAllMembers is false.
config.visibilityOrder: Specifies the sorting order of member visibilities within each group (e.g., ['public', 'protected', 'package', 'private']). Leave empty to skip visibility sorting.
config.sortAllMembers: Whether to sort all class members. If false, fields, enum constants, and initializers will remain in their original positions.
